monsters.name: clockroach
monsters.description:
A common dungeon pest that combines the worst features of a scavenging insect and a looming deadline.

Time flows strangely around it, rewinding any injuries inflicted upon it unless the source of them is near enough to be caught up in its timestream.

Max HP: ~11      Will: +           AC: +          EV: ++                        
    rF: ...        rC: ...      rPois: x        rNeg: ...       rElec: .        
Threat: High    Class: Natural   Size: V. Small  Int: Animal    
Speed: 120% (normally travels faster than you)

You have about 62% to hit with your +0 hand axe and 50% to hit with your headbutt.
It has about 56% to hit you.

Attack  Max Damage  
Bite    4           

To read a description, press the key listed above. (AdB) indicates damage (the sum of A B-sided dice), (x%) indicates the chance to defeat your Will, and (y) indicates the spell range; shown in red if you are in range.
Spells:
Sandblast: (3d7)
statuses: Damage-immune at range:
This creature takes no damage by any means unless the original source of that
damage is adjacent to them. Non-damaging side-effects happen normally.
(The source of damage from clouds and projectile-like monsters, such as
foxfires, is always considered whatever creature first created them.)
